linkedin:
Only 23% of 4,441 active remote jobs on Loker Dollar actually show a pay figure. Here's what that tells job seekers.

Out of 4,441 live remote listings, just 1,000 (23%) include salary or hourly pay. The other 3,441 (77%) keep compensation private. Before you assume that means low wages, the data suggests otherwise — many firms expect candidates to negotiate.

What we found:
• 2,753 listings (62%) are open to applicants anywhere in the world.
• Communication is the top skill: 1,662 of 4,282 listings (39%) require it.
• AI is now a prerequisite in 12% (517 listings) — among the fastest-growing skill demands.
• Leadership (10%), Sales (8%), Project Management (7%), and Data Analysis (7%) round out the list.
• 1,560 distinct companies are hiring, including Neo Financial, TELUS Health, IDG, Hitachi, and Jobgether — but only Neo Financial discloses its pay ($5/hour).

For Indonesian talent chasing remote USD jobs, the takeaway is clear: filter for worldwide-open roles and negotiate, because most pay stays hidden.

Read the full breakdown and browse the live board → https://lokerdollar.com/en/blog/global-remote-jobs-2026
